mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish: current conditions are clear near the Verona Public Library with a temperature of 54 degrees, feeling like 44 under a Waxing Gibbous moon.

The city has announced that municipal buildings will be closed November 26 and 27 for Thanksgiving, which will also delay refuse and recycling pickup until Friday. Meanwhile, plans are underway for a new public works facility and ongoing road improvements on Mark Drive and Legion Street to support our growing community.
There is plenty to do this weekend, including live music at Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's happening today, followed by music at Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow, and yoga sessions on Sunday.
On November 6, officers responded to a business on West Verona Avenue where they found a driver unconscious in their vehicle; the individual was subsequently arrested for O W I.
Stop by for a scoop of today's flavor, Crazy for Cookie Dough, as the restaurant opens today at 10:00 AM to kick off your morning.
